title: Blade of the Immortal
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In Tokugawa-era Japan, the ronin Manji, whose violent past cost his sister her husband, is made unable to die by 'sacred bloodworms' given by an 800-year-old nun. To regain his mortality and atone, he vows to kill 1,000 evil men, and becomes the bodyguard of Rin Asano, a girl seeking revenge on Anotsu Kagehisa, whose Itto-ryu swordsmen murdered her parents.
life_message: It asks whether vengeance and atonement through killing can ever bring peace, and holds up loyalty between Manji and Rin.

delivery.note: Whether killing brings peace is asked through the revenge plot rather than answered by narration.

winners_losers: Manji and Rin survive through loyalty, while ruthless factions like Itto-ryu and Mugai-ryu are shown paying in blood. Sympathy goes to the weary, loyal bodyguard rather than to any school of the sword.
